reason: The Stage 07 draft has three blocking observability/provenance defects. First, it has no immutable stage/revision/attempt/agent implementation identity and no measured compact lifecycle for cache validation, market bundle construction, feature construction/snapshot finalization, outcome materialization, DATA_READINESS, model fitting, prediction, or the service boundary; the service record also omits available schema/calendar/stage identity, evidence count, latency, readiness hash and training-data provenance, and labels feature as_of as feature_materialized_at. Second, arbitrary evidence_ids cross MarketFeatures.to_state_slot and MarketForecastService.forecast unchanged, while DATA_READINESS persists an unbounded run_id; offline PRIVATE_SENTINEL counterexamples proved both paths. Third, identity and temporal/readiness binding is incomplete: the service accepts MarketFeatures for a different ticker/as_of while reporting the requested context identity; labeled_snapshot_from_mapping accepts an outcome materialized before target_date; build_data_readiness accepts rows outside the versioned universe/effective membership and lacks upstream source date-range evidence; and fit_deterministic_model accepts rows different from those evaluated by the supplied readiness manifest because the readiness artifact is not bound to an eligible-row content hash.

requested_changes.request: Add one immutable Quant implementation identity in tools/market_tools/__init__.py for stage=07, stage_revision=1, attempt=1, agent=quant and derive compact allowlisted lifecycle metadata from it. Measure monotonic finite non-negative latency at the Stage 07 boundaries that actually execute: cache validation/bundle construction, feature build/snapshot finalization, outcome materialization, DATA_READINESS, model fit, prediction and service forecast. Include run_id, ticker, as_of, target, horizon, analysis_mode, dataset/feature/model/schema/calendar versions where available, semantic counts, evidence_count and bounded degraded flags. Never emit raw bars, feature vectors, coefficients, labels, evidence IDs, exceptions or full input/output payloads. Add deterministic offline lifecycle-matrix and failure-path privacy tests. Make the forecast record include truthful materialization/provenance fields; do not relabel as_of as feature_materialized_at.

Validate run_id and evidence references at the first Stage 07 boundary with a compact, whitespace-free reference policy and bounded cardinality/length. Preserve only opaque reference IDs in State and forecast output; telemetry receives counts only. Add PRIVATE_SENTINEL tests proving raw/private evidence text and multiline or oversized run IDs are rejected and absent from State, output and lifecycle metadata.

Bind every MarketFeatures instance used for forecasting to the exact ForecastContext ticker/as_of/dataset/feature identity and reject mismatches. Validate fixture snapshots against the central 21-session target rule and reject outcome_materialized_at before target availability. Enforce each labeled row's ticker, benchmark and as_of against the universe constituent effective interval before DATA_READINESS PASS; record real per-source temporal coverage or explicit missing/unverified status. Derive a canonical eligible-row content hash (including snapshot identity and labels) in DATA_READINESS and require model fitting to reproduce it before fit. Add offline counterexamples for mismatched feature identity, pre-target fixture outcome, out-of-universe rows and modified rows fitted under an unrelated readiness manifest.

evidence: A scoped source scan found zero QUANT_IMPLEMENTATION_IDENTITY, compact_lifecycle, forecast_trace_metadata, publish_forecast, elapsed_latency_ms, time.perf_counter, stage_revision or attempt call sites under tools/market_tools and the locked Stage 07 tests.
PRIVATE_SENTINEL raw article text supplied as an evidence_id was returned unchanged by both MarketFeatures.to_state_slot and MarketForecastService.forecast.
PRIVATE_SENTINEL raw private prompt supplied as DATA_READINESS run_id was persisted unchanged in the manifest.
MarketForecastService.forecast accepted ticker=AAPL/as_of=2020-01-31 MarketFeatures with an MSFT/2024-06-28 ForecastContext and reported MSFT while retaining the mismatched feature as_of.
build_data_readiness returned PASS for MSFT rows under an AAPL-only universe manifest.
fit_deterministic_model accepted a label-mutated row set under a readiness manifest built from the original rows.
